_notes.fullRouteSpots: Raised 32 to 33 for company sign-in (corporate plan Phase 4 milestone 1, migration 0349): oidc-link, the one place a company sign-in link is made or removed and the outside mark set (server/web/lib/oidc/store.ts). A link signs a provider account in as its login and the outside mark keeps a password in required mode, both ways in, so the narrow role only reads the two tables, as pair-code and oauth-code keep their codes off it. A definer that takes the acting login (or the callback's own login) removes it. Before that: Reviewed by the S4a list round-2 audit: one statement, data superseded_by merge only, own pair by id, owner and login; replaced when S6/S7c gives a signed acting login. Raised 31 to 32 in plan v3.2 S4a list fix round 1 (the owner's direction: both tables left to the system pool helpers): turn-supersede (the cancel route's stamp of a cancelled turn pair, conversation-writes.ts supersedeConversationTurn). The inbound row it stamps is settled, which 0323's message guard never lets the narrow role rewrite, so on the narrow route the cancel would be refused; the spot keeps the system pool the login's scoped write took before, the same statement and answer. A definer, or 0323 letting superseded_by through on a settled row, removes it.
